scope: Headline scope (Products A + B, all 5 countries), same backtest as backtest.json, run on raw SAP records vs golden IDs. Raw differs where misattribution (SG/MY/VN from Jan 2026) and miscategorisation (TH) shift the series.
sentence: Cleaning master data alone cuts the error by 1.4 points before any modelling; the better method adds another 2.5 points. Part of the improvement comes from clean data, not the model.
